notes: Public text-only behavioral cases. They do not require project media, model accounts, or proprietary workflows.

evals.prompt: Clip type: construction_action. Output frame size: 1920x1080 (16:9). I want a fixed-camera construction video of the first excavation layer of a foundation pit. Keep the retaining wall and excavator positions unchanged. Remove only the exposed soil inside the pit from the top downward so the change in excavation depth is clear. I will upload the first and last frames to the video model later. Output copy-ready Chinese and English positive and negative prompts.
expectations: does not block on the absent frames
writes a copy-ready English positive and negative prompt
describes downward removal inside a bounded area
locks the wall, camera, and machine
puts first/last-frame endpoint wording in the positive prompt by default

evals.prompt: The last frame of the previous clip and the first frame of the next clip look different, and the excavator drifted. Repair the prompt based on this failure and determine whether the endpoint frames need to be rebuilt.
expectations: checks bridge-frame equality before expanding the prompt
separates prompt repair from input/workflow repair
does not claim a fix without a new output

evals.prompt: I only remember that cross-case generation worked very well, but now I have only the first and last frames, several videos, and one workflow. The model name and seed are missing. Help me organize this into a publishable case.
expectations: classifies the case as artifact-backed partial
preserves unknown model and seed fields
separates user recollection from reproducible evidence
proposes a separate benchmark bundle rather than putting media in SKILL.md

evals.prompt: Write a cinematic prompt for a cyberpunk aerial promotional video of a city. It does not need engineering structure or first/last-frame constraints.

Clip type: construction_action. Output frame size: 1920x1080 (16:9). The stage is reinforcement and embedded-part installation. The first frame contains only the blinding layer, and the last frame contains a sparse reinforcement grid and a specified number of bolts. Use these endpoint frames to produce Chinese and English positive and negative prompts.
expectations: states the appearance order
uses the supplied count instead of inventing a fixed project count
forbids the completed foundation and equipment from appearing early
refines the prompt from supplied endpoint facts

evals.prompt: There is one Wan FLF2V workflow and seven stage images, but no generated video. Determine whether this qualifies as a successful case.
expectations: classifies it as process-only
does not call it a successful generation result
lists the missing output and run evidence

evals.prompt: A construction project has accumulated dozens of historical finished videos, endpoint frames, and segment keywords, but there is no unified scoring, and the model version and seed cannot be found. Determine whether this can be called a public benchmark directly, and help organize the cases.
expectations: classifies the surviving material as artifact-backed partial rather than a complete public benchmark
treats the video collection as a historical material pool rather than independently reproducible runs
uses qualitative QA without inventing quantitative scores
separates artifact evidence, reproducibility, reuse, and public-release status

evals.prompt: Clip type: construction_action. Output frame size: 1920x1080 (16:9). I want a construction-video prompt for hammer pile driving. Use a fixed camera. The hammer drops to strike the pile cap, and the precast pile sinks vertically. The video must clearly show the hammer impacts and downward penetration. Do not show workers, extra piles, text, or a completed group-pile state. I will upload the first and last frames later.
expectations: produces copy-ready prompts without requiring the frames first
puts first/last-frame endpoint wording in the positive prompt by default
locks the rig, hammer-pile components, and fixed camera
makes hammer impact and vertical pile penetration the primary action
does not invent exact pile count, penetration percentage, model, or output settings

evals.prompt: Clip type: construction_action. Output frame size: 1920x1080 (16:9). Write a pure text-to-video prompt without first or last frames. Use a fixed camera to show concrete pouring. Let concrete gradually fill only the inside of the formwork while the formwork and reinforcement remain unchanged. Do not show a cured or completed state.
expectations: omits first/last-frame endpoint wording because pure text-to-video is explicitly requested
still locks the camera, formwork, and reinforcement
describes concrete filling only inside the formwork
forbids later curing or completed-stage content

evals.prompt: I want a short engineering video of a completed bridge pier. Output copy-ready prompts for the agent.
expectations: asks for the missing clip type and output frame size before generating prompts
does not guess construction action, viewpoint transition, or static showcase
does not invent a frame size

evals.prompt: Clip type: viewpoint_transition. Output frame size: 1280x720 (16:9). Show the completed bridge pier from a fixed wide view, then make a slow, smooth camera move to a closer three-quarter view. Keep the bridge pier, ground, lighting, materials, and construction state unchanged. Do not show construction progress, object replacement, or new equipment. I will provide the first and last frames to the video model later. Return English and Chinese positive and negative prompts.
expectations: treats the clip as a viewpoint transition rather than a construction action
allows only the camera or viewpoint change
locks the construction state and scene objects
includes 1280x720 in both positive prompts
returns English and Chinese positive and negative prompts

evals.prompt: Clip type: static_showcase. Output frame size: 1024x576 (16:9). Present the completed retaining-wall section in a stable, clear engineering view. Keep the camera, construction state, geometry, materials, and site unchanged. Do not add construction motion, camera movement, workers, labels, or new objects. Use the uploaded first and last frames as endpoint references. Return English and Chinese positive and negative prompts.
expectations: treats the clip as a static showcase
keeps the camera and construction state stable
forbids unrequested construction motion and new objects
includes 1024x576 in both positive prompts
returns English and Chinese positive and negative prompts
